title: CodeFlow Layers Config (codeflow.layers.yaml → CORE validation)
$comment: codeflow.layers.yaml is YAML on disk, validated as JSON after yaml->json conversion. CORE reads it on every publish_core_flow.

strictOrder.description: When true, layer order violation is an error. When false, violation is a warning + unknowns[].

allowUnknownLayer.description: When false, raw layer not in name/aliases → layer_order_violation error. When true → maps to unknown with warning.
